overall_animation_style_notes: Overall this is a deadpan, minimal-motion comedic style: a single static medium shot of a flat-affect wool-felt woman delivering dialogue via mouth-only animation, with a secondary black-hooded 'low battery' character frozen mid-gesture in soft-focus background depth.
